rules: A data field shows one piece of information about an object as a label and its value (an email, a status, an owner, a creation date) for reading, not for editing. A value the user can change is an entry control in a Field; a disabled or readonly control is never used to display a value.

label is required and non-empty, set in typographyLabel in labelColor; it wraps. value is set in typography in valueColor and wraps, breaking long words (identifiers, addresses) rather than overflowing.

value holds the value prop as plain text, or free content given by the integration instead (a Badge, a Link, an Avatar followed by a name, several lines); the content inherits typography and valueColor.

When value is empty and no content is given, empty shows an em dash in emptyColor, hidden from assistive technology, followed by emptyLabel, which is announced and not displayed; the label never disappears, so that fields keep their place in a layout.

vertical stacks label above value, aligned at the inline start, gap apart. horizontal places label at the inline start in a column of labelInlineSize and value beside it after columnGap, both aligned on their first baselines; when the field is narrower than twice labelInlineSize, horizontal stacks like vertical. Fields of the same layout therefore align their values without a shared container.

The relation between label and value is exposed: the field is a group named by its label, and the value follows the label in reading order. A set of fields is laid out by the integration (a grid of columns, a list); the data field adds no margin around itself.

The data field is not interactive and has no state: it is never focusable and emits no events; interactive content in value (a Link) keeps its own behavior. Copying, editing in place and actions belong to the integration.
Sizes change the typographies (sm for dense panels and tables of properties, md by default); the typographies do not change with density, the gaps do.
In forced-colors mode label, value and the em dash use the system text color.
